_comment: Multi-turn conversations over the indexed Grade 6 science textbook.
Single-turn evals cannot see the failure these exist to measure: a turn
is only wrong relative to the turns before it.
expect: answers  -> grounded, cites the syllabus, and stays on `about`
refuses  -> no citations; the syllabus does not cover it
chats    -> answered without searching at all
about:  a word the answer must contain, which is how continuity is checked
without asking a model whether two answers are about the same thing

conversations.name: a student who does not understand

turns.say: Can you explain to me evaporation, please?
I feel that I still don't understand. Would you explain to me in layman's language, in a simpler way, maybe using bullets or making it easier for me to understand?
can you break that down into bullet points

conversations.name: small talk in the middle of a lesson

turns.say: ok now explain the layers of the atmosphere

conversations.name: asking for what the book does not have

turns.say: ok, back to watersheds — give me an example
